name: Chromatic Dragon, Pink
body:
CE dragon (air, water)

BASE STATISTICS

Subpages

CR 5; Size Small; Hit Dice 6d12
Speed 40 ft., swim 40 ft.
Natural Armor +5; Breath Weapon cone, 2d4 acid plus grease
Str 12, Dex 15, Con 12, Int 10, Wis 11, Cha 10

ECOLOGY

Environment coastal cliffsides
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Binding Suds (Su)

The breath weapon of an old or older pink dragon prevents flight to those that fail their save against it. The affected behave as if under the effects of a clipped wings spell. Pink dragons are immune to this effect.

Blinding Suds (Ex)

The breath weapon of an adult and older pink dragon causes blindness to those that fail their save against it. This blindness lasts 1 round per HD of the dragon. This is an acid effect.

Nonslip Step (Ex)

Unfazed by slippery terrains such as ice or the effects of a grease spell, a pink dragon navigates these surfaces with effortless grace, moving unhindered through regions characterized by such conditions.

Spume (Su)

An ancient or older pink dragon can use its breath weapon to create a cloud of acidic suds as a standard action that deals damage to any creature inside it. The cloud moves with the dragon and has a radius of 20 feet. When it’s created, anyone inside this area takes an amount of damage equal to half the dragon’s breath weapon, with a Reflex save for half damage. The number of damage dice rolled is halved each round until the result would be less than 1d4. Any creature that starts its turn inside the cloud takes damage, but can make a Reflex save for half. A strong wind or water current disperses the spume in 1d4 rounds. The spume affects creatures as if they encountered the dragon’s breath weapon, including the grease effect, and binding and blinding enhancements if they are available.

Spell-Like Abilities (Sp)

A pink dragon gains the following spell-like abilities, usable at will upon reaching the listed age category. Young—vanish; Juvenile—fumblestep; Adult—staggering fall; Old—hostile levitation; Ancient—tailwind; Great wyrm— gravity well. Sudsy Breath Weapon (Ex)

A pink dragon’s breath weapon is a cone of caustic soap suds that cause the area of effect to be under the effects of a grease spell with duration of one minute per HD of the dragon.

Water Breathing (Ex)

A very young pink dragon can breathe underwater indefinitely and can freely use its breath weapon, spells, and abilities while submerged.
